messages:
alex: Heads-up — seeing repeated BMC UDP packet floods on oob-mgmt vlan in ap-south1. Multiple BMC warmboots and SecureBoot flag toggles on ~6 nodes (r12{3..14}). Loss ~48 GPUs. Anyone oncall?

opsbot: [ALERT] ap-south1:oob-bmc-udp-rate-high — 6m avg > 5k pkts/s; affected-tag: rack-r12-r14; incident_id=inc-20290301-01

priya: looking into network ACLs, pulling syslogs now.

jordan: I'll take lead for remediation. Alex — paste the syslog snippet and BMC serials so I can kick off recovery.

alex: 
```
Mar 01 01:11:23 bmc-drv[2923]: udp_recv: flood detected from 10.254.99.21:12345 -> 623, rate=6200pps
Mar 01 01:11:27 system: watchdog: warmboot requested
Mar 01 01:11:28 uefi: nvram_write: var SecureBoot = 0x0 (was 0x1)
serials: BMC-R12-03,BMC-R12-04,BMC-R13-01,BMC-R13-02,BMC-R14-05,BMC-R14-06
```

priya: suggests we apply immediate egress/ingress rate limits on the BMC VLAN. Quick rule: `iptables -A INPUT -p udp --dport 623 -m hashlimit --hashlimit 1000/s --hashlimit-mode srcip --hashlimit-name bmc_udp -j ACCEPT` then drop rest. Will test on canary.

jordan: alternate short-term: flip nodes to secondary BMC image (recovery) for 3 canary nodes (r12-03/04, r13-01). That should stop the warmboot loop while we block flood. Note: we saw one node with UEFI var corruption after the warmboot; need nvram restore from artifact and then re-assert secureboot via HSM KMS policy.

lee: please update runbook, and tag impacted capacity so billing/sales know. Customer-facing impact = potential queries for Dedicated customers in ap-south1. Estimate capacity loss ~48 GPUs (~6 GPU-hours so far). If we burst to other regions to keep SLAs, cost delta ~+$2k/hr (rough estimate).

deploybot: Patch build queued: `bmc-fw-hotfix-20290301` (tests: firmware-integrity, nvram-sanity). ETA: 3h. Will require maintenance window to apply to all racks.

priya: Plan: 1) apply iptables rate-limit on oob-mgmt (canary now) 2) flip 3 canary BMCs to recovery image 3) restore NVram SecureBoot var from artifact and re-enroll keys to KMS 4) schedule hotpatch during 02:00-04:00 UTC window 5) update runbook and notify customers. I'll open CCR and post the runbook link.

alex: sg. I'll tag infra-impact and notify support to queue customer comms. :thumbsup:
